Regulator seizes nearly R1m in non-compliant goods

Inspectors from the national regulator seized non-compliant goods worth about R976,000 during an inspection of shops in the town on 15 September.

The items included electrical products without approval, child car seats and meat with obliterated use-by dates, the regulator said in a statement.

The regulator said the inspections form part of a national programme to remove unsafe products from shelves.
